title: 第十五章 糙米肉饼第十六章 新人师姐
slug: 从白猿拳破限开始成就人间武圣
content_zh:
翌日清晨，朝阳照常升起。
苏羽将屋内最后一点值钱的家当打包，又看了眼那卷发霉的被褥，最终还是无奈地折好。
“这一去，不知何时能回。”
锁上斑驳的木门，苏羽心中生出几分萧索。
“吱呀！”
这时，隔壁刘叔家的门扉悄然裂开一道缝隙。
一只瘦得像火柴棍的小手扒着门框，那双占了半张脸的大眼睛，空洞洞地盯着苏羽。
是刘叔的小闺女，丫儿。
她不说话，不出来，也不关门，就像一具被抽走了魂魄的木偶。
苏羽眉头微皱，上前两步，放轻声音：“丫儿，有事？”
丫儿没有回答，也没有动作，就那么静静看着苏羽。
“咳咳咳！”
这时，屋内突然传来一阵撕心裂肺的咳嗽声，像是要把肺叶子都咳烂了吐出来。
苏羽听着声音不太对，推门而入。
丫儿还是无声的站在门口，只有空洞的眼珠随着苏羽的身影转动。
屋内，一股浓烈的腐朽气息扑面而来。
床上，刘叔像是一根干瘪的树枝，蜷缩在床上，盖着一床破了洞的烂棉絮，露出溃烂发黑的双脚。
苏羽过来，刘叔也没睁眼，只是身体在不断发抖着。
活不久了。
苏羽心中叹了一口气，抬眼看了一圈屋内，蛛网布满房梁角落，灰尘覆满唯一的木桌。

发黑的灶台，生冷粗粝，不知道多久没开火了。
他转过身，看着那个只到自己腰间、瘦骨嶙峋的小女孩。十来岁的年纪，轻得像一阵风就能吹走。
“饿吗？”
丫儿依旧不语，只是那只枯瘦的小手，怯生生地拽住了苏羽的衣角，死也不肯松开。
苏羽沉默片刻，转身出门。
丫儿的眼神瞬间黯淡下去，那只手无力地垂落。
但很快，脚步声去而复返。
苏羽扛着半袋糙米大步走了进来。
之前家中采购的糙米，去了武馆后，也没吃完，如今倒是剩下了不少。
“砰。”
米袋落在灶台上，震起一片灰尘。
这一声闷响，也让丫儿眼中多了一丝神采，莫名的眼神盯着那米袋。
苏羽看到那道莫名的眼神，平静的心中泛起了一丝涟漪。
这或许是一种对生命的眷恋吧。
想了想，他从衣服口袋掏出自家钥匙，塞进那只鸡爪一样的小黑手：“丫儿，这是我家钥匙。我不在家的时候，你帮我打扫屋子，看着点家，这袋米是工钱。”
“若有人找我，你就去村东头苏鸿家报信。等我回来，若是屋子扫得干净，还有工钱。”
丫儿死死攥着那把钥匙，重重地点了点头。
……
白猿武馆，居住区。
苏羽回到房间，把被褥拿出去晒了晒，又来到水井边洗衣。

今日还是休沐，阳光也不错，不少学徒也都在井水旁洗衣，晾晒，闲聊。
content_en:
The next morning, the sun rose as usual.
Su Yu packed up the last valuable belongings in the house, looked at the moldy bedding again, and finally folded it helplessly.
"I don't know when I can come back now."
After locking the mottled wooden door, Su Yu felt a little desolate in his heart.
"Squeak!"
At this time, the door of Uncle Liu's house next door quietly opened a gap.
A small hand as thin as a matchstick was holding the door frame, and the big eyes that took up half of his face were staring at Su Yu blankly.
She is Uncle Liu's little girl, Ya'er.
She didn't speak, didn't come out, and didn't close the door. She was like a puppet whose soul had been drained away.
Su Yu frowned slightly, took two steps forward, and lowered his voice: "Ya'er, what's the matter?"
Ya'er didn't answer or make any move, she just looked at Su Yu quietly.
"Cough cough cough!"
At this time, a heartbreaking coughing sound suddenly came from the room, as if the lungs were being coughed up and spit out.
Su Yu heard that the voice was not right, so he pushed the door open and entered.
Ya'er was still standing silently at the door, only her empty eyes turning following Su Yu's figure.
Inside the house, a strong smell of decay came.
On the bed, Uncle Liu looked like a withered branch, curled up on the bed, covered with a piece of rotten cotton batting with holes in it, exposing his ulcerated and blackened feet.
When Su Yu came over, Uncle Liu didn't open his eyes, but his body was trembling.
Not long to live.
Su Yu sighed inwardly and looked around the room. Cobwebs covered the corners of the beams, and dust covered the only wooden table.
The blackened stove was cold and rough, and it hadn't been turned on for who knows how long.
He turned around and looked at the skinny little girl who only reached her waist. At the age of ten, he was as light as a gust of wind could blow him away.
"Are you hungry?"
Ya'er remained silent, but her thin little hand timidly grabbed the corner of Su Yu's clothes and refused to let go.
Su Yu was silent for a moment, then turned and went out.
Ya'er's eyes dimmed instantly, and her hand dropped weakly.
But soon, the footsteps came back again.
Su Yu strode in carrying half a bag of brown rice.
The brown rice purchased at home was not finished after going to the martial arts school, but now there is a lot left.
"Bang."
The rice bag fell on the stove, stirring up a cloud of dust.
This muffled sound also made Ya'er's eyes look brighter, and she stared at the rice bag inexplicably.
When Su Yu saw that inexplicable look, a ripple appeared in his calm heart.
This may be a kind of attachment to life.
After thinking about it, he took out his house key from his pocket and stuffed it into the little black hand like chicken feet: "Ya'er, this is my house key. When I'm not at home, you help me clean the house and look after the house. This bag of rice is wages."
"If anyone comes looking for me, go to Su Hong's house in the east of the village and report the news. When I come back, if the house is clean, there will be wages."
Ya'er clutched the key tightly and nodded heavily.
…
White Ape Martial Arts School, residential area.
Su Yu returned to the room, took out the bedding to dry it, and then went to the well to wash the clothes.
It was still a day off for bathing today, the sun was good, and many apprentices were washing, drying and chatting beside the well water.
